text: Beyond [Spirit Sickness](spirit_sickness), three more things can settle on you out there:
- **Unsung Hush**: The Unsung's Silence bolts take your voice with them. For **12 seconds** no song and no staff voice will answer. Wait it out, or wash it off.
- **Frayed**: the touch of a Loom-torn creature, an **Echo Weaver** above all, tears something out of you: **two hearts** of your health for **two minutes**. Milk does nothing for it.
- **Ley Sickness**: the ground sways and your Pulse drains from every cell you carry. It comes from standing on a bare ley crossing while the threads surge.
pages.title: What the March leaves on you

text: Every [remedy](remedies) lifts all of them, and the [Healing Circle](healing_circle) and a night in the [sweat lodge](sweat_lodge) do too.

The old way is the **Spirit Well**: find one in the March, step into its water and **sneak**. For **40 Pulse** from a cell you carry, the well takes every affliction from you, Spirit Sickness included.
pages.title: Washing clean
